# Chanuka Jeewantha — Premium Resume, CV & LinkedIn Services

> Founder-led, premium career-branding service writing ATS-optimized resumes, executive CVs, LinkedIn profiles, cover letters, and full career-branding suites for senior professionals, executives, C-suite leaders, and founders targeting competitive English-speaking job markets — the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand — and remote-first companies. Every document is written personally by Chanuka Jeewantha (not templated or junior-outsourced) and tailored to the client's target market, industry, and career level. Service is delivered fully remotely worldwide.

## About

- Provider: Chanuka Jeewantha (founder-led, personally written)
- Website: https://www.chanukajeewantha.com

- Positioning: Premium / executive tier — built for senior candidates competing for serious roles, not budget catalogue editing
- Payment methods: Wise, PayPal, Payoneer, Stripe, bank transfer

## Services

- [ATS Resume & CV Writing](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services/cv-writing): ATS-optimized resumes and CVs engineered for recruiter scrutiny, hiring-manager logic, and senior-level competition.
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimization](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services/linkedin-optimization): Recruiter-facing LinkedIn rewrite built around positioning, keyword strength, and credibility signals senior hires are searched on.
- [Cover Letter Writing](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services/cover-letter-writing): Tailored cover letters matched to the role, company, and hiring committee.
- [CV Review](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services/cv-review): Expert review of an existing CV/resume against target-market conventions and ATS compatibility.
- [Executive Resume & Modern CV Format](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services): Senior-level formats for cross-border applications, hiring panels, and recruiter-led searches.
- [Graphical / Premium Design CV](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services): Premium visual CV for industries where presentation and personal brand carry weight.
- [Career Consultation](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services): Founder-led strategy sessions on positioning, market fit, and next move.
- [Personal Website](https://www.chanukajeewantha.com/services/personal-website): Personal branding website for senior professionals.

## Key questions (FAQ)

- Do you work with clients anywhere in the world? Yes — fully remote, designed for professionals applying to roles in competitive English-speaking markets (US, UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand) and remote-first companies.
- Do you write resumes or CVs? Both — structure is adapted to the client's target market, industry, career level, and application purpose.
- Can you tailor a CV for a specific target market? Yes — each document follows the target market's conventions (format, length, tone, recruiter expectations).
- Do you guarantee interviews or jobs? No — the service improves quality, positioning, ATS compatibility, and recruiter-readiness; outcomes depend on market conditions, applications, and employers.
- What payment methods are available? Wise, PayPal, Payoneer, Stripe, and bank transfer.
- How do I start? Submit your current CV/resume, target role, target market, and preferred package via the enquiry form.
